summary: The registrant filed an 8-K to disclose an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program via a Controlled Equity Offering Sales Agreement with Cantor Fitzgerald and Curvature Securities. The company may sell up to $750 million of common stock from time to time on a continuous basis, with proceeds intended for AI infrastructure development and general corporate purposes. No specific terms such as price or premium are stated, as this is a sales agreement, not a fixed-price offering. The filing is a routine capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation. The company may suspend or terminate the agreement at any time.
